milestone: PUBLIC PROVENANCE RECOVERY / GENERATOR AUDIT ONLY
evidence_policy: Static public source/documentation only. Generator options and script intentions do not bind released scenarios. No matching numbers, filenames alone, or sensor similarity used as linkage evidence.
supported_release_grammar_scope: Field interpretation of a supplied full path only; not an enumerated ID inventory or family relationship.

suffix_semantics.is_sequential_renumbering: NOT_ESTABLISHED; no renaming source was found

generator_naming: Timestamp-based run directories differ from released scenario-N grammar. Hydra multirun job numbers identify sweep jobs, with no public mapping to released suffixes.
test_fixture_warning: Public devkit fixtures explicitly use in-memory stub records; their scenario-0/scenario-1 examples do not prove release existence or relationships.
safe_identifier: Full split-qualified scenario path can identify an individual scenario if a publisher metadata inventory later supplies it; this audit constructs no such inventory or family IDs.

evidence.detail: Run timestamp naming and multirun job-number naming.
Normal test uses test-clip callbacks, 30 seconds, normal output prefix.
Weather anomaly extends test-clip and uses weather-type output prefix.
Discovers local observation sidecar paths and counts RGB files; no embedded inventory.
WithIdentifiers returns full record path, not a family ID.
In-memory stub scenario examples are synthetic fixtures, not released inventory.
